# Golden fixtures — provenance

A fixture without provenance is an unfalsifiable assertion: nobody can tell a
hand-checked expectation from one generated by the code it is meant to catch.
Every file here names who recorded it, when, and from what. The expectations
themselves live beside the tests that assert them, hand-read from these
snapshots — never regenerated from a normalizer (**ADR-0009**).

Snapshots are stored **verbatim**, so provenance lives here rather than inside
them: an added metadata key would change the bytes the fixture exists to
preserve.

| File | Recorded | By | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rescuegroups-available.json` | 2026-08-17 | Claude, hand-checked with Logan | Live `POST /v5/public/animals/search/available/` (`limit=2&page=1`). Per-request `meta.transactionId` dropped; records otherwise untouched. Expectations in `tests/rescuegroups.test.ts`. Also the e2e seed (`e2e/seed.ts`), which clones it into variants and restamps their dates in memory — the file itself is never rewritten. |

| `irs-bmf-sample.csv` | 2026-10-27 | Claude, read by Logan | Hand-made, NOT a download: twelve rows in the exact column layout (three of them — ARF and St Sophia's Forgotten Felines in Wheaton, Touched By An Animal in Chicago — copied from the real `eo_il.csv` of 2026-10-27 with the care-of names blanked, after the matcher missed ARF-IL and Cats-Are-Purrsons-Too) of the IRS Exempt Organizations Business Master File (`eo_il.csv`, header read 2026-10-27), with fictional organisations, EINs and addresses. It exists to pin the matcher's behaviour on the ways a listed name differs from a legal one — legal form, word order, a foundation beside its body, a care-of line, a quoted name, a short EIN, another state's namesake. Expectations in `tests/ein-match.test.ts`. The real file is public domain and lands under `var/irs/`, never here (ADR-0029 §2). |

Per-site scrape fixtures land here at shelter onboarding (roadmap item 5), one
row each.
